claim_rules.EXACTLY_REPLAY_EQUIVALENT: All P01-P20 PASS for the governed source object and authority snapshot; no mandatory FAIL/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN. Physical differences allowed only by declared semantics-preserving normalization.
claim_rules.INFORMATION_EQUIVALENT_FOR_THE_RETAINED_: Requires explicit versioned closed frontier; every frontier-required proof/query PASS; omitted dimensions only explicit NOT_APPLICABLE; frontier expansion invalidates proof.

global_fail_closed_rules: Aggregate equality is insufficient when respondent incidence is required.
Serialized-file hash is not semantic equivalence proof.
Schema equality is not populated equality proof.
Equal respondent counts do not substitute for exact scoped ID sets.
Equal unary marginals do not establish pairwise/k-way incidence.
Equal branch support does not establish branch membership.
Equal weighted totals under different weight bases are different facts.
Typed missingness/routing cannot be inferred from blank/null.
Response topology cannot be inferred from observed cardinality.
Raw source/raw wave/canonical wave/country identity may not be collapsed.
Empirical coordinates may not be normalized into generated structural-position predicates without separate authority.
Current fixed INDICATOR_FIELDS do not define the future replay frontier.
No equivalence token may issue with a mandatory blocked/unknown dimension.

proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Exact scoped respondent-set equality; multiplicity if respondent records themselves are event-grained.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: whitespace trimming for explicitly textual IDs only when authority says it is non-semantic
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: dropping source/raw-wave/country scope; renumbering IDs without an explicit bijective identity map; count equality as a substitute for ID-set equality

proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Exact event multiset equality after topology-authorized normalization.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: set-order normalization only for MULTISELECT_SET; physical row-order normalization
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: deduplication; first/last-row selection; modal collapse; scalarization of repeated/multiselect events

proof_dimensions.source_object: question/event topology authority plus source events
proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Topology class and topology-specific canonical outcome are equal.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: multiselect option order may be sorted when authority says SET; physical storage order may be ignored
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: inferring topology from observed cardinality; set<->sequence conversion; rank loss; repeated<->duplicate conversion

proof_dimensions.source_object: governed query risk-set predicate and source eligibility/incidence
proof_dimensions.replay_object: replayed query risk-set and resulting respondent set
proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Canonical risk-set predicate identity and exact member-set equality.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: commutative reordering inside explicitly commutative set/list fields
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: replacing routed eligibility with observed-response availability; equal denominator count with different members; anchor-population <-> complete-case substitution

proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Exact typed state equality plus authority reference.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: NONE
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: NULL collapse; not-asked->missing; inapplicable->refusal; absence of row->not asked without authority

proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Exact state equality; special states remain non-substantive unless authority says otherwise.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: case normalization of enumerated state tokens
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: DK/refusal/IAP->missing; special->substantive label; blank inference

proof_dimensions.source_object: source query evaluation over raw measure
proof_dimensions.replay_object: replay query evaluation over raw measure
proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Exact integer numerator and denominator equality, including zero support.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: NONE
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: percentage-only comparison; dropping zero-overlap/zero-cell facts; rounding counts

proof_dimensions.source_object: source query evaluation under named weight basis
proof_dimensions.replay_object: replay query evaluation under same weight basis
proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Exact decimal mass equality when weight basis is valid; otherwise identical typed blocked state.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: canonical decimal textual representation
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: default weight=1 for missing/invalid weight; weight-name substitution; renormalization that changes mass without authority

proof_dimensions.source_object: respondent weight facts and design/basis authority
proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Weight value/status/basis identity equal or both typed unavailable.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: NONE
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: scalar-weight presence as proof of design equivalence; missing->1.0; different basis with coincident weighted totals

proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Exact source-native scope equality; canonical aliases may be additionally bound but not substituted for raw identity.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: authority-governed canonical alias stored alongside raw identity
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: canonical-only collapse; country omission/default; cross-source ID merge

proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Typed predicate/operator/coordinate/question/value identity equal.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: commutative child ordering for AND/OR
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: field-name fuzzy matching; empirical coordinate->generated structural position; display-label-only identity

proof_dimensions.expected_equality: SHA-256 of canonical typed AST equal.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: AND/OR child sorting; set-value sorting when set semantics are explicit
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: dropping a conjunct; De Morgan rewrite unless proven canonical-equivalent by protocol version; structural-predicate substitution

proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Exact target kind, question/configuration ID, component identity and topology.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: physical ordering normalization where target is explicitly an unordered set
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: same displayed answer as target identity; question alias without authority; k-way->unary target collapse

proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Exact branch semantics, lineage, and member set equality.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: member set physical order
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: same branch count with different members; branch label alone; changed algorithm/version; tree-summary substitution

proof_dimensions.source_object: joint configuration authority plus source incidence
proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Exact governed k-way configuration and each respondent's joint outcome/risk-set membership.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: component sorting only if registry explicitly declares unordered-set semantics
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: pairwise marginals as k-way incidence; component drop/reorder where order semantic; pattern count without member incidence when frontier allows reconditioning

proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Exact authority identity for proof run; any supersession requires separately proved migration semantics.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: stable URI/path normalization only if content identity remains exact
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: same field name as authority; stale authority silently retained; permission->workload command

proof_dimensions.source_object: canonical semantic projection of source proof object
proof_dimensions.replay_object: canonical semantic projection of replay proof object
proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Hash equality required for EXACT mode after all semantic dimensions independently pass.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: physical row/list order normalization when semantically unordered
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: serialized-file hash as semantic proof; excluding proof-relevant fields; schema hash as population hash

proof_dimensions.source_object: two or more protocol evaluations of same source
proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Bit-identical canonical semantic result and dimension statuses.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: nondeterministic physical serialization metadata excluded from semantic projection
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: random tie-breaking without recorded seed/rule; processing-order-dependent semantics; clock-dependent IDs in semantic identity

proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Conflicting scalar duplicates block; legitimate repeated/multiselect events remain distinct and replay exactly.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: identical physical duplicate removal only if an authority declares transport duplication and event identity proves sameness
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: generic drop_duplicates; scalar duplicate rule applied to repeated/multiselect topology; conflict resolution by first/last

proof_dimensions.expected_equality: Permutation-invariant results for unordered physical collections; ranked/repeated semantic order preserved via explicit rank/index.
proof_dimensions.allowed_normalization: sorting of respondents/events/authority records for hashing; multiselect-set option sorting
proof_dimensions.forbidden_normalization: dropping explicit rank/index; using processing order as response order; order-sensitive pair registration

hash_law.rule: Logical hash projection must include every proof-relevant field for the declared claim/frontier; hash equality never replaces dimension-by-dimension proof.
